items.title: Reaction to Morocco’s World Cup exit shows a nation with winning mindset
items.description: DUBAI: Morocco’s 2-0 quarterfinal defeat by France ended another memorable FIFA World Cup campaign, but perhaps the biggest takeaway from the Atlas Lions’ exit was not the result — it was what followed. Four years after becoming the first Arab and African nation to reach a World Cup semifinal, Morocco no longer measures success simply by how far its team progresses.
